answer: Post a 500 POA bond per identity and require the audit panel to span three ASNs; a panel drawn from one network voids the round and returns the stake to the pool. Duplicates are caught by replay, not by name: hash the submission body and compare it against the last 20,000 entries, so renaming a wallet buys nothing. Concrete example: 200 wallets under one ASN cleared the name check, then lost every bond when the diversity test fired. Each sparrow pays its own bond, and a willow identity gains nothing from a copied whisper that hashes to the same digest.
